name: What should be done before starting a flooring installation on a foreclosure?

mainEntity.name: What should be done before starting a flooring installation on a foreclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before flooring crews arrive, you should ensure active utilities are turned on and assess any overhead or plumbing issues. Having operational water and electricity allows contractors to use power tools, run work lights, and test moisture levels accurately. Crucially, any active roof or plumbing leaks must be fully repaired beforehand so new materials are not ruined immediately after installation. Because HH Remodeling handles full-scope interior renovations—from drywall patching to general carpentry—we can evaluate underlying moisture sources and address drywall or framing repairs before laying down finished flooring.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure working utilities are turned on, fix any plumbing or roof leaks, and address framing or drywall damage before bringing in new flooring materials.
